variants.about_this_item:
Inspired by our vast grasslands and cold northern lakes, ACANA™ Grasslands is brimming with lamb, duck, eggs and wild-caught fish, in WholePrey ratios of meat, organs and bone. Our ingredients are delivered to our kitchen fresh or raw* by people we know and trust, giving your dog the best ingredients and a recipe that will keep them happy, healthy, and strong.

1. 70%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. FIRST 3 INGREDIENTS FRESH OR RAW LAMB, DUCK & EGGS
3. FREEZE-DRIED COATED FOR TASTE
4. PREBIOTICS AND FIBRE TO SUPPORT HEALTHY DIGESTION
5. VEGETABLES, FRUIT, BOTANICALS & NUTRIENTS
6. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Raw lamb (8.5%), raw duck (8.5%), eggs (8%), lamb meal (8%), herring meal (7%), turkey meal (7%), whole green peas, whole red lentils, whole chickpeas, raw freshwater lake fish* (5%), fish oil (4%), raw lamb liver (4%), duck liver (4%), raw turkey (4%), whole green lentils, whole pinto beans, whole yellow peas, lentil fiber, duck fat (2%), pea starch, dried kelp, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, freeze-dried duck and liver, freeze-dried lamb and liver, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, whole cranberries, whole blueberries, whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips.*varied mix of raw tullibee, whitefish, northern pike, and mullet.

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 35% Fat content 17% Crude fibre 6% Crude ash 8% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.7% Phosphorus 1.2% Omega-3 fatty acids* 1% Omega-6 fatty acids* 2.3% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.2% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.2%
